name: Autopan
description: A stereo auto-pan insert for a track (a WIDENS effect, ABI 1.12): an LFO on the side, so a mono sound swings between the ears and a stereo voice keeps its own image; the mid is untouched, so the mono sum stays the input. The cycle is a sequencer length (Sync 1..15 = 64, 32, 16, 12, 8, 6, 4, 3, 2, 3/2, 1, 3/4, 1/2, 1/3, 1/4 steps, locked to the pattern's beat through get_clock; 0 = free) or a period in milliseconds; Shape 0 sine, 1 triangle, 2 square; depth and phase. HEADPHONE ON swaps the speaker law for a cheap binaural cue (the far ear delayed up to 0.6 ms and darkened by a head-shadow low-pass that follows the pan): it is NOT mono-compatible (the delayed ear combs in a mono sum), so it is off by default. Four factory presets. A stereo effect needs OS-INSFX-ABI2 A4 on the unit; the lock to the pattern needs A3.
